The Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) is a premier space agency in India. It is responsible for the development of space technology and its application to various fields.

ISRO has achieved numerous milestones in space exploration and has become a leading player in the global space industry.

About the Programme

The ISRO URSC Apprentice programme is designed to provide training and experience to graduate and diploma holders in various fields.

The programme aims to develop the skills and knowledge of the apprentices and prepare them for a career in the space industry.
